details.name: The Berber Dynasties
details.summary: Earthen Berber house remixes across Ages I-IV
details.author: hossein81 and marcokistan
details.description: Stock Abbasid houses repainted with earthen plaster, timber and geometric trim. Native house geometry, selectors and team-colour layers retained. Complete 0.2.1 tent and Tuareg content preserved. Native test pending.
details.changelog: House-only visual update: four age variants, private scaled stamps and private tier bindings. Remove competing Malian outskirts-house visuals; preserve gameplay and previous assets.
